facts.text: Evan enjoys skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating as winter activities.

evidence.quote: Skiing, snowboarding, and ice skating are all fun winter activities I enjoy.

facts.text: Evan expressed a desire for Sam to join him in participating in winter activities.

evidence.quote: I'd like you to join me, too. Winter activities are a blast - hopefully someday you will!

facts.text: Evan had a positive experience skiing in Banff, describing the snow as amazing and expressing a desire to return next year.

evidence.quote: Yeah, it was great for skiing! The snow was amazing and I had a lot of fun. Can't wait to go back next year!

facts.text: Sam expressed uncertainty about participating in winter sports due to physical limitations.

evidence.quote: I'd love to try it but I'm not sure my body can take it.
